content.text:
Merged `origin/main` into `attach-improvements` and resolved the one conflict.

The conflict was in `cmd/entire/cli/attach_test.go`, where both sides had touched the same assertion in `TestAttachBlocksWhenPolicyWriteUnsupported`: this branch changed the `runAttach` call to pass a separate stderr writer, while main strengthened the assertion to check the actual error message ("checkpoint policy cannot be satisfied by this Entire CLI"). I kept both — the two-writer call signature (which matches the merged `attach.go`) with main's stricter assertion.

Verification: `go vet` is clean and all `TestAttach*` tests in `cmd/entire/cli` pass. The merge commit is `1e8484376`. I didn't run the full `mise run check` suite — worth doing before you push.
Before pushing, the project requires `mise run fmt && mise run lint` to pass. Running that now.
